functionDeclarations.name: list_products
functionDeclarations.description: List or search products. With filter[type]=manufactured it returns the population the Launch Roadmap checks (skip rows with a non-null archived_at). With filter[search] it finds an ingredient the sheet names instead of giving its SKU. BOM lines accept only products that carry stock (standard, kit, blemished, manufactured). (GET /api/v2/products)

filter[type].description: Comma-separated product types, e.g. manufactured, or standard,manufactured.

filter[search].description: Free-text search across SKU, name, barcode, MPN and brand.

per_page.description: Page size (default 10). Iterate page until last_page.

functionDeclarations.name: list_boms
functionDeclarations.description: List BOMs with product_id, status, version_number, component_lines_count and archived_at. Archived BOMs are excluded unless filter[archived]=all. (GET /api/manufacturing/boms)

filter[search].description: Matches BOM id, BOM name, or the product's name or SKU.

functionDeclarations.name: find_product_by_sku
functionDeclarations.description: Resolve an ingredient or part SKU from the recipe sheet to its product id and type. (GET /api/products/by-sku)

functionDeclarations.name: list_units_of_measure
functionDeclarations.description: The account's units of measure (id, name, code, type). Use to map the sheet's units ("kg", "ea", "ml") to uom ids. (GET /api/manufacturing/units-of-measure)

uom_type.description: Optional filter by unit type, e.g. weight.

functionDeclarations.name: get_product_units
functionDeclarations.description: The units of measure enabled for one product (its stock unit plus alternates). A BOM line's uom_id must be one of these. (GET /api/manufacturing/products/{product}/units-of-measure)

functionDeclarations.name: create_bom
functionDeclarations.description: Create one BOM with its component lines. product_id, name and effective_from are required; the primary output line (product_id x 1) is added for you when output_lines is omitted. Returns the BOM with its id and lines. (POST /api/manufacturing/boms)

product_id.description: The manufactured product this recipe makes.

status.description: BomStatus: draft, active or archived. Send draft; a person activates it after review. Over the MCP server leave it out (sending it is refused; MCP BOMs are always drafts).

version_notes.description: Free text — record the source sheet and row here.

expected_yield_percent.description: 0–100. Only when the sheet states a yield.

default_consumption_method.description: forward_flush or backflush. Omit unless the user says how they issue materials.

output_lines.description: Omit for a single finished product. Each { product_id, role (primary, coproduct, byproduct, scrap), quantity, uom_id }. Use it when one batch yields more than one unit (product_id, role primary, quantity 12) so component quantities are per batch.

component_lines.description: The recipe. Each { product_id (required), quantity (required, >= 0), uom_id (optional — defaults to the product's stock unit; must be enabled on the product), expected_scrap_percent (0–100), consumption_method, is_optional, notes, sort_order }. The roadmap counts a BOM only when it has at least one component line.

functionDeclarations.name: get_bom
functionDeclarations.description: Fetch one BOM with its component and output lines, to verify after creating it. (GET /api/manufacturing/boms/{bom})
